preconditions.description: Input constraints: n (students), d (days), and k (buses) are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(k, int) and isinstance(d, int)
preconditions.description: Input values n, k, and d are integers.

postconditions.expression: k**d < n or (len(stdout_lines) == d and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdout_lines) and all(all(1 <= int(x) <= k for x in line.split()) for line in stdout_lines) and len({tuple(int(stdout_lines[i].split()[j]) for i in range(d)) for j in range(n)}) == n)
postconditions.description: If k^d < n, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output consists of d lines each with n integers between 1 and k, such that every student has a unique sequence of bus assignments across all d days.
